name: csvFormatRow
description: Formats an array (or a single scalar, treated as a one-column row) as a CSV row string. A field is quoted when quoteAll is true or the field contains the delimiter, the quote character, or a newline; the quote and escape characters are doubled inside quoted fields. A null element produces an empty, unquoted field. This matches the opencsv behaviour of the Java CSV shim, keeping round-trips byte-identical.

params.name: values
params.description: Array of values to format (or a single scalar for a one-column row).

params.name: escape
params.description: Single-character escape character (default the quote character).

params.name: quoteAll
params.description: Quote every field, not only those that need it (default true).

examples.title: Format a row
examples.description: Quote-all formatting of a simple array.
